record.context_brief: Jung-type rigidity toward the hyperfinite factor
record.original_question: Let N be a Connes embeddable separable II_1 factor. If every pair of embeddings of N into the ultrapower R^U of the hyperfinite II_1 factor are conjugate by an automorphism of R^U, must N be isomorphic to R?

evidence.quote: Problem 34. If a Connes embeddable separable II1 factor N satisfies that any pair of embeddings of N into RU are conjugate by an automorphism of RU, then is N ∼= R?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $R$ denote the hyperfinite $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor and fix a free ultrafilter $\mathcal{U}$ on $\mathbb{N}$. Write $R^{\mathcal{U}}$ for the tracial ultrapower of $R$. A separable $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor $N$ is called Connes embeddable if there exists a (trace-preserving, unital, $*$-) embedding $N \hookrightarrow R^{\mathcal{U}}$.

Suppose $N$ is a Connes embeddable separable $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor with the following property: for every pair of embeddings $\pi_1, \pi_2 : N \hookrightarrow R^{\mathcal{U}}$, there exists an automorphism $\alpha \in \mathrm{Aut}(R^{\mathcal{U}})$ such that $\pi_2 = \alpha \circ \pi_1$.

Must $N$ be isomorphic to $R$?
artifact.status_search_result: Jung's classical theorem (2007) shows that if all embeddings of a Connes-embeddable separable II_1 factor N into R^U are unitarily conjugate, then N ≅ R. The variant in question weakens unitary conjugacy to conjugacy by an automorphism of R^U. Related work by Atkinson–Goldbring–Kunnawalkam Elayavalli on the "generalized Jung property" addresses embeddings of N into N^U (not R^U), proving R is the unique R^U-embeddable generalized Jung factor in that sense. The precise question with embeddings into R^U up to Aut(R^U)-conjugacy does not appear to be resolved in the literature and is listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Factorial relative commutants and the generalized Jung property for II_1 factors
status_evidence.snippet: R is not the unique generalized Jung factor, but R is the unique R^U-embeddable generalized Jung factor.
status_evidence.claim: Related (but distinct) generalized Jung problem—about embeddings into N^U—is partially resolved; the R^U-version with automorphism conjugacy remains as stated.

status_evidence.title: Amenability, tubularity, and embeddings into R^omega (Jung)
status_evidence.snippet: Jung's theorem: a Connes-embeddable separable II_1 factor with all embeddings into R^U unitarily conjugate must be R.
status_evidence.claim: The unitary-conjugacy version is solved; the automorphism-conjugacy weakening is the open variant.
